parsed.note_claim: The image of an Israeli passport for Pam Bondi is AI-generated and not authentic, and Bondi is of Italian ancestry with no evidence of Israeli citizenship.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: there is no evidence the image authentically depicts an Israeli passport belonging to Bondi. It was generated with artificial intelligence and originated from a social media account that describes itself as satirical.
parsed.reason: The Snopes fact check directly states the passport image was AI-generated, with no evidence it is authentic, and that Bondi is of Italian ancestry.
